### Injustice
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-16-2015.html
Passage: Amos 5:14-15, 24
Points:
- Ancient prophetic warnings against perverted justice remain urgently relevant to modern society.
- Contemporary culture often distorts morality by excusing wrongdoers while blaming innocent victims.
- Courtrooms and public systems risk becoming theatrical spectacles manipulated by bribes and bias.
- Believers are called to hate evil, love good, and actively work to rectify injustice.

### Devotional: Amos 5
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/1-chronicles-7-8-hebrews-11-amos-5-luke-11-38/
Passage: Amos 5:1-27
Points:
- The prophet combines funeral laments with urgent evangelistic appeals to shatter the complacency of a hostile audience.
- Seeking the Lord Himself is infinitely more essential than maintaining outward, aesthetic forms of worship.
- Genuine repentance demands a tangible hatred of evil alongside practical integrity and justice in public courts.
- Religious fervor and longing for revival are empty when accompanied by moral ambivalence and social oppression.
